about_the_game:
🐾 Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids! 🐾
Ever dreamed of a world where cats and mermaids become one? In Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids, hatch magical cores to reveal adorable Mermeows—each with its own quirky personality and charm. Watch these enchanting cat-mermaids drift gracefully through beautifully hand-drawn lakes in a serene, idle clicker adventure.

🌍 Explore Four Enchanting Biomes
Begin your journey at the peaceful Magical Lake sanctuary, then unlock Molten Lagoon, Spectral Swamp, and Celestial Archipelago. Each realm hosts 20 unique Mermeow types along with environmental buffs from decorations and lake upgrades, transforming your waterside retreat into a vibrant haven.

🐚 How to Play:

  • 💖 Open Chests: Discover Mermeow Cores hidden within magical chests.

  • 🌊 Hatch in Shells: Use the cores in magical shells to awaken new Mermeows.

  • ✨ Shimmer & Fuse: Instantly earn pearls with shimmer or fuse cores to boost quality before hatching.

  • 🐾 Watch & Drift: Enjoy the gentle drift of your Mermeows as they simply swim in your lakes.

  • 💎 Collect Pearls: Earn pearls passively or ascend your Mermeows for extra rewards.

  • 🏡 Expand & Decorate: Upgrade your lakes, add more hatching spots, and decorate to unlock additional buffs.

  •  🎶 Mellow Music: Each biome features its own exclusive soundtrack to fully immerse you in this gentle world.

    ✅ Adorable Mermeows: Each Mermeow comes in one of four quality tiers—Normal, Charmed, Enchanted, and the ultra-rare Ethereal—with 20 unique types per biome waiting to be discovered.
    ✅ Minimalist Animation: Enjoy the soothing, effortless movement of your Mermeows without any flashy distractions.
    ✅ Engaging Idle & Clicker Mechanics: Boost your hatching process with active clicks or let your serene aquatic companions work in the background—even offline (up to a 24-hour cap).
    ✅ Fusion & Enhancement: Enhance your cores with shimmer or fuse multiples to hatch rare, high-quality Mermeows and boost their unique traits for increased pearl production.
    ✅ Achievements & More: Unlock rewards as you expand your sanctuary and nurture your growing collection of uniquely charming Mermeows.

🌀 A Serene Collector’s Journey
For those who love idle games with a calm, artistic aesthetic, Mermeow: Chill Cat Mermaids offers a visually soothing escape. Hatch, ascend, and marvel at the quiet beauty of your Mermeows as they drift through their dreamy world.

💦 Start your magical journey today! 💦

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0 compatible GPU (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or AMD Radeon HD 4000 series)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card

short_description: Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids – where every splash brings a smile! In this enchanting idle clicker creature collection game, traverse hand-drawn lakes, hatch unique Mermeows, and upgrade serene habitats. Collect pearls and let magical currents carry you into a world of calm strategy.
